name: fig-brush
description: Analyze a scientific plot screenshot and create an editable Origin template with replaceable local placeholder data.

interface.shortDescription: Create editable Origin templates from scientific plot screenshots.
interface.longDescription: fig-brush reads a reference figure, records its visual structure, creates transparent placeholder data, and uses a local Origin installation to create an editable .opju template. The screenshot workflow does not upload files from the local MCP process; compatibility data tools can read CSV/XLSX paths explicitly supplied by the user.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create an editable Origin template from my scientific plot screenshot; I will replace the clearly mapped placeholder data locally.
